# ANDERSEN A-SERIES DH CONFIGURATION FINDINGS DOCUMENT

## 1. PRODUCT OVERVIEW


Designed for architectural authenticity, these are our best-performing, most energy-efficient windows and patio doors
. The DH configuration refers to double-hung windows. 
A tilt sash option isn't available on all windows but it is available as an option for the Double-hung window in the A-Series. Andersen calls this feature the "Easy Tilt-to-Clean"
.

**Material Class:** 
Choose from a variety of beautiful interior wood species, with fiberglass and composite exteriors that won't peel, blister, fade or corrode, and resist water while sealing out the elements
. 
Fibrex is an Andersen made composite material made of a combination of vinyl and wood shavings
.
  
**Configuration Type:** Double-hung (DH)  
**Country of Origin:** United States

## 2. CONFIRMED FINDINGS

**Frame Construction:** 
Made of wood protected by fiberglass and Fibrex® composite material, it's our best-performing double-hung window
. 
The A-Series windows are clad with fiberglass and Fibrex composite
.

**ENERGY STAR Recognition:** 
Our A-Series windows with triple-pane glass are rated ENERGY STAR Most Efficient for 2023 and 2024
. 
The A-Series is Andersen's best performing energy efficient window. The windows in this series have been recognized by ENERGY STAR as some of the most efficient residential window models available in the U.S. and Canada

## 4. RED FINDINGS

**Active Recall (2026):** 
This recall involves window opening control devices sold individually as kits or as factory-installed accessories and applied to 100 Series casement windows that were manufactured prior to November 19, 2025. Consumers should leave the recalled windows with the opening control devices in the closed and locked position and immediately contact Andersen Windows to schedule a free in-home repair by an authorized technician
. NOTE: This recall affects 100 Series, not A-Series products.

**Installation Method Concerns - INSTALL-CONFOUND: HIGH**
